sections.value: You are commanded that within forty-two (42) days after service of this writ on you, inclusive of the day of such service, you do cause an appearance to be entered for you in an action at the suit of the claimant, and take notice that in default of your so doing the claimant may proceed therein and judgment may be given in your absence.

value:
Use this information to enhance the draft:
The role is 'Claimant & Defendant'.

The orders sought can be so many. Hence it should always begin with, 'A DECLARATION', because an originating summons is only for the interpretation of a document, acts, laws, contracts etc.

Where it involves, probate or administration of a trust or settlement, then it should have 'In the matter of the Trust or settlement', or else just remove that entire sectionTitle.

In FCT it is 42 days after service, while in Lagos it is always 21 days after service, unless outside jurisdiction it becomes 42 days.

To be on the safer side, if the state is located on the southern part of Nigeria, use 21 days.

If Defendant's address is outside jurisdiction, then use this clause before the date 'This originating summons (or as the case may be) is to be served out of ____ state of nigeria and in the ,  _____ state of nigeria.'

.
The draft should be within 500-7000 words.

Use today's date, to fill the date section.
